I decided to move the chicken pen to a more shaded area, under the mulberry. The deer keep coming in to eat the fallen berries, so it's a food source I can remove from them to keep them out of the yard.

The old pen area was more or less waste dirt, with old wood and car parts piled up when I moved in three years ago. It has been greatly enriched with all the chicken shit and compost they've dug through. I think next year I will move the pen again, and let them keep working over the soil in places its crappy.

Tilled up the area to level it out, and I'm going to plant some malting barley for a fall harvest. With hops, an assortment of traditional European beer herbs, and hops, I'm looking forward to my wife brewing some beer that came entirely from the products of my garden. https://files.catbox.moe/b3rnw4.jpg

I have an absolute ass load of berries. To the point that my kids are even sick of picking them. The raspberries have just started producing and I've got bags of them frozen. It is cool to just go grab fistfulls of berries each morning to toss in my lunchbox.

The blackberries are just about ripe. This is one of five plants. https://files.catbox.moe/cixtq3.jpg

Still getting strawberries. The June bearing ones are done for the year, leaving me with gallons of them frozen, but these guys are just starting up for the year. https://files.catbox.moe/pr79oj.jpg

Gooseberries and currants from the last harvest. I've been trimming these guys back pretty hard to get a thick main trunk. I want them to grow as a small shrub, rather than as shaggy bushes, so they don't shade out the strawberries underneath. https://files.catbox.moe/8r87lf.jpg

The bog I made is doing well. Acidic and nutrient deficient enough that nothing is trying to grow in it. I moved the blueberries to its edge, as they need more water and sun vs where I had them. https://files.catbox.moe/nkwy1t.jpg

Mulberries out the ass. My kids have pretty much been camping under the trees stuffing themselves with them. https://files.catbox.moe/qmb8hj.jpg
